meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction for International Companies)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage, complemented by locally enacted statutes and customary law elements)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (No. 11 of 1987), as amended (incorporation of International Companies, share register, registered office and registered agent obligations; nominee shareholders permitted, but the licensed registered agent must maintain a beneficial ownership register accessible to the Registrar and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (No. 24 of 2007), as amended (AML/CFT customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, record-keeping and suspicious transaction reporting obligations of licensed registered agents); directives and guidance issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; FATF Recommendations as implemented through Samoa's membership of the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the holder, with signature certified by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the issuing state is an HCCH Contracting Party, including the People's Republic of China since 7 November 2023) OR Consular Legalization (where the issuing state is not an HCCH Contracting Party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The financial institution maintaining the applicant's or beneficial owner's account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original signed bank letter; where issued by a foreign bank, the bank officer's signature must be notarized and the document apostilled or consular-legalized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization in accordance with the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a qualified practicing attorney or certified accountant (in active practice for not less than 5 years)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm or accounting firm of the applicant's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization in accordance with the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed shareholder and beneficial owner due diligence questionnaire and source-of-wealth declaration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The licensed International Companies agent must apply risk-based customer due diligence under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, as amended: (i) universally screen all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners and their immediate family members and close associates for Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status; (ii) screen all such persons against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN List, the UK HM Treasury Consolidated Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Sanctions List and any domestic designations notified by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; (iii) verify identity through certified passport, address and bank reference evidence; (iv) apply Enhanced Due Diligence where a PEP, designated person, or high-risk FATF-monitored jurisdiction is identified; (v) retain all CDD and beneficial ownership records at the Samoa registered office for not less than 5 years after termination of the business relationship; and (vi) file suspicious transaction reports with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit where any suspicion arises. The target activity (standard-risk online retail of pet supplies and pet care devices, ISIC 4791) does not itself trigger mandatory Enhanced Due Diligence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); name availability searches and clearance applications are submitted exclusively through a licensed International Companies Agent, as direct public e-filing is not available for International Companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registered name must be expressed in Roman/Latin script; where the desired name originates in a non-Latin script, a mandatory English transliteration or translation must be filed as the official registered name. A Chinese-character name may be recorded as a parallel secondary name in the charter and on the certificate of incorporation, provided the Roman-script registered name appears first on all formal documents and the Chinese name is a transliteration or translation of it.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name clearance is valid for 30 days from approval. If incorporation cannot be completed within the window, the licensed agent may apply in writing for one automatic extension of up to 30 additional days, stating the reason for delay. Upon rejection, the licensed agent may file, within 14 days, a formal administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, annexing the rejection notice and demonstrating that the proposed name is neither identical nor confusingly similar to any existing registered name and does not breach a prohibited token; an adverse decision may then be referred for ministerial review by the Chief Executive Officer of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour. In the alternative, the agent may submit two substitute names for a fresh clearance without an additional government fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure e-commerce operator (ISIC 4791) may conduct all substantive commercial activities remotely, and no physical Samoan place of business beyond the registered office is required for this category. However, every International Company must maintain a physical statutory registered office in Samoa at the licensed International Companies Agent's address; a 'virtual office' cannot satisfy this statutory requirement and is permissible only as an ancillary administrative or marketing arrangement in addition to the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of this standard-risk, non-licensed e-commerce business is below 5%. Regulatory inspection activity is primarily directed at licensed registered agents rather than the International Company itself; an unannounced physical inspection of the company's stated premises would occur only upon complaint, regulatory suspicion, or sanctions/PEP-related scrutiny.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 4–14 (incorporation, registered office, and registered agent); the Act also confers statutory income tax, stamp duty, and exchange control exemptions on International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Companies Office, Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1), filed together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account or capital deposit is required. Shares may be of no par value, and the initial subscriber share is deemed fully paid in the subscribed sum.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of International Companies is hereby accepted and adopted; (2) the single subscriber share of no par value be allotted, issued, and credited as fully paid to the founding shareholder upon receipt of the subscribed sum; (3) the Company's registered office shall be situated in Apia, Samoa, at the office of the licensed registered agent, and said agent is approved and appointed; (4) the persons named in the consent forms be and are hereby appointed as directors and secretary, each consenting to act; (5) the directors are authorized to open bank accounts, engage Stripe and PayPal as payment processors, and execute all ancillary documents; and (6) a common seal be adopted. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Subscriber Due Diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Office, Registrar of International Companies, Apia, Samoa (counter or e-portal pre-clearance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for two alternative names, each ending with 'Limited' or an approved suffix, and confirm the name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered company or protected mark. Provide certified identity and address documents for the subscriber and execute an engagement letter with a licensed Samoan registered agent who sponsors the filing.
required_dossiers: Proof of residential address of subscriber
Engagement letter from licensed Samoan registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected name is refused, immediately submit the second-choice name; an administrative objection may be filed with the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum, Articles, and Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Samoan registered agent and notary public in Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber executes the Memorandum and Articles of Association and the instrument appointing first directors; each proposed director and the secretary execute Consent to Act forms; the registered agent executes the Registered Office Agent Acceptance. All signatures must be witnessed; notarization is required where documents are executed outside Samoa.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director (each director)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any execution defect is cured by re-signing the instrument or by lodging a deed of correction with the Registrar together with a covering letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Office, Registrar of International Companies, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 with the signed constitutional documents, consents, registered office particulars, and the prescribed government fee (approximately US$200) at the Companies Office counter or through the approved electronic filing portal. The Registrar verifies compliance with the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to Act forms for directors and secretary
Registered office particulars and agent acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a requisition, the applicant has 21 days to respond by amending documents or supplying missing declarations; rejected applications may be re-filed without additional penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Office, Registrar of International Companies, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent collects the certificate and certified copies of the constitutional documents; the instrument appointing first directors takes effect on the date of the certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate of Incorporation is corrected on written request to the Registrar with the supporting statutory forms.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance Activation, Banking, and Payment Processor Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors, licensed registered agent, licensed banks in Samoa, and payment processors (Stripe, PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The board adopts the pro-forma first board resolution, opens a corporate bank account with a licensed bank in Samoa, maintains the registered office through the licensed registered agent, and files the corporate due diligence questionnaire with Stripe and PayPal. The company may also obtain a Certificate of Good Standing and a tax-exemption confirmation letter from the Ministry of Revenue.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms and KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Banking or processor onboarding rejections are cured by submitting updated beneficial ownership declarations; the board may appoint an alternative payment processor or bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies to this offshore international e-commerce entity; administrative oversight remains with the MCIL Companies Office. If a physical warehouse were later established in Samoa, the Commerce and Trade Division of MCIL would register the local business activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — the company conducts electronic retailing of pet supplies exclusively on an offshore basis, holds no Samoan consumer-facing trading licence, and has no manufacturing permit obligations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA registration required for pure offshore online retail with no physical construction, land disturbance, or emissions in Samoa; a full EIA Report would only be triggered by any future warehouse or logistics development.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the current activity. If a local facility is ever established, wastewater and trade waste discharges must comply with the Water Resources Management Act 2008 discharge standards, and e-waste and packaging waste are regulated under the Waste Management Act 2010; VOC emission limits are not applicable to non-manufacturing retail.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to the offshore virtual operation; if an office or warehouse is opened in Samoa, the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) requires a fire safety certificate and occupancy clearance, and structural load inspections must comply with the Samoa National Building Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa (Inland Revenue Division); official online portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws. Corporate and International Company registry oversight: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), https://www.sifa.gov.ws.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) is an offshore exempt entity and is not required to obtain a Samoa TIN or VAT registration number. Its statutory tax identity is the certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing issued by SIFA; no revenue-ministry TIN is issued unless the IC is compulsorily registered for a local taxable activity (which an IC is generally prohibited from carrying on). If a foreign entity nevertheless requires a Samoa VAT/TIN identifier for a permitted limited purpose, it must submit Form VAT-1 (Compulsory Registration), together with SIFA certificate, articles of association, directorship details, and a local physical or registered-office address, to the Ministry of Revenue. A TIN/VAT number is then issued within the turn-around time applied by the Ministry, subject to anti-avoidance review.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election, hybrid-mismatch election, or look-through classification exists under Samoa tax law. The applicable elections are corporate-law based: (a) an IC may elect in its articles to avail itself of the tax-exempt status conferred by the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); (b) it may by special resolution elect to continue or re-domicile to another recognized jurisdiction; (c) it may elect to register as a domestic company, which prospectively surrenders the offshore tax exemption but does not create a retroactive Samoan tax liability for the period of exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 2000, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 50,000 (Samoa tala) of taxable supplies made in Samoa during the current or any preceding consecutive 12-month period. An International Company operating as a pure offshore e-commerce vendor of pet supplies to non-resident customers does not, by reason of a registered office in Samoa alone, have a Samoan VAT registration nexus; the threshold applies only to persons carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa, which an IC is statutorily barred from doing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a mandatory continuous transaction control regime, real-time fiscal clearance, electronic invoice stamping, or API-based e-invoicing requirement. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a tax invoice containing the supplier's name and address, VAT registration number, date, description, quantity, price, and VAT chargeable. VAT returns are filed electronically or in paper through the Ministry of Revenue's prescribed forms; no separate electronic clearance bride interface is required for standard exports.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAT Act 2000, exports are zero-rated where the goods are physically exported from Samoa by the supplier or on the supplier's behalf within the time limits prescribed by the VAT regime, the supply is made to a purchaser resident outside Samoa, and the supplier retains documentary evidence of export. For services, zero-rating applies to Services supplied to a person not resident in Samoa where the benefit is derived entirely outside Samoa. A Samoa International Company, being an exempt offshore entity, is not a VAT-registered taxable person; therefore it neither charges VAT on overseas online pet-supplies sales nor claims export VAT refunds. If an IC were wrongly or compulsorily VAT-registered, it may zero-rate genuine export supplies only on the complete customs and banking documentation set described below.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Export Declaration (electronic SED or Customs Export Entry) showing the exporter of record and the foreign destination
Bill of Lading (sea) or Airway Bill (air) evidencing physical departure from Samoa customs territory
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list matching the export declaration
Inward remittance certificate, SWIFT credit advice, or bank statement evidencing receipt of foreign-currency proceeds from the non-resident buyer
Certificate of origin (where preferential tariff treatment is claimed) and any supplier/exporter contract or purchase order
Proof of export within the statutory VAT deadline (e.g., cargo manifest, customs clearance stamp, or freight carrier departure record)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner of Revenue may conduct retrospective audits of zero-rated export claims, including inspection of customs export records, transportation documents, bank FX flows, and counterparty contracts. Where zero-rating is found to have been claimed fraudulently or without sufficient export evidence, the claim is set aside, the VAT becomes due from the original supply date, and all interest and penalties accrue as provided under Samoa tax and customs laws. The Revenue may claw back any refund or credit previously granted, set it off against other taxpayer liabilities, and pursue the debt as a civil tax debt without limitation periods for fraud. Administrative penalties apply for false declarations, failure to keep records, and unregistered taxable activity, and the directors/officers of the supplier may face personal liability and criminal prosecution for tax evasion. The burden of proving that the goods were exported and consideration remitted from outside Samoa rests entirely on the claimant, and the Ministry of Revenue is not bound by any prior clearance or refund decision when fraud is subsequently discovered.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is convertible for current international transactions; Samoa maintains no exchange restrictions on payments and transfers for current-account purposes, but all inward and outward transfers are subject to statutory reporting and exchange-control monitoring by the Central Bank of Samoa. Capital-account transactions, including equity injections, shareholder loans, assignment of shares, and liquidation repatriations by non-residents, require prior CBS exchange-control approval or authorization processed through a licensed commercial bank. Profit/dividend remittances are treated as current transfers once the underlying financial statements are audited, filed, and tax compliance is evidenced; for a Samoa International Company operating in the offshore ring-fence, transactions are executed in foreign currency, which minimizes local WST conversion friction. Principal remittance hurdle: absent a clean UBO register, audited accounts, and a CBS-approved capital verification file, dividend and capital repatriation instructions may be suspended at the correspondent-bank level for de-risking reasons.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Where the IC physically exports goods from Samoa, the Exchange Control Regulations require export proceeds to be received through a licensed Samoan commercial bank within ninety (90) days of shipment, and, unless a foreign-currency-account retention exemption is granted by the CBS, 100 percent of repatriated proceeds must be offered for conversion into WST at the prevailing CBS-determined commercial rate within the prescribed surrender window. For the target ISIC 4791 model (electronic retailing of pet supplies), inventory is ordinarily drop-shipped from third-country suppliers to end-buyers without Samoan customs export, so no export surrender obligation is triggered; the IC must nevertheless maintain documentation proving the absence of territorial export and must repatriate to Samoa any sales proceeds that are booked or received in Samoa within the standard repatriation window.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Foreign-Currency Account / Capital Escrow Account
Multi-Currency Operational Account / Capital Girop Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium, with strict legal boundaries. Samoa does not license foreign digital electronic money institutions (EMIs) as banks; EMIs such as Stripe, PayPal, Payoneer, Wise, and Airwallex may be used only as unlicensed payment-collection and disbursement switches, never as the primary treasury depository. Legal constraints: (i) any EMI activity that accepts Samoan-resident funds in WST without a CBS banking or money-remittance licence would constitute unlawful deposit-taking/money transmission; (ii) global EMIs routinely freeze accounts of Samoa International Companies lacking economic-substance documentation; and (iii) card-network rules restrict the EMI to merchant-of-record fronting rather than corporate treasury clearing. Recommended architecture: Stripe/PayPal as card-acquiring rails sending net settlements via automated payout to the ANZ or BSP Samoa account, with EMI accounts used solely for supplier payables denominated in third-country currencies.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is the default requirement: at least one natural-person director or appointed senior authorized signatory must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Apia branch before the account is activated. Pure remote end-to-end opening is unavailable for newly incorporated International Companies; however, ANZ and BSP will exceptionally accept an introducer letter from a CBS-licensed Samoan registered agent, a certified board resolution designating signatories, and notarized ID/certified passport copies, followed by a live video-call compliance interview. The Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (as amended) mandates identification of every ultimate beneficial owner; email-only verification is insufficient.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company classification under the International Companies Act 1987, with non-resident shareholders, nominee-management profile, and historic bearer-share secrecy perception.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified current Register of Directors and Register of Members or UBO register filed under the IC Amendment regime; CBS-licensed registered-agent introduction letter; tax-residency and tax-exempt status confirmation from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue; group structure chart; source-of-funds declaration for initial capital; sworn transparency undertaking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-ticket card collections from numerous retail pet-product buyers creating unusual AML velocity against a newly opened corporate account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant processor settlement statements (Stripe/PayPal); refund and chargeback policy; marketplace supplier agreements; inventory and logistics proof; written AML transaction-monitoring policy with defined flagged-transaction thresholds; projected monthly gross-volume memo.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from third-country jurisdictions without prior exchange-control filing or verifiable economic purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed board resolution for capital injection; CBS capital-authorization confirmation; source-of-wealth declarations; statutory declaration of beneficial ownership; e-commerce platform evidence (domain registration, active listings, supplier contracts).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound supplier payments to counterparties in heightened-risk trade corridors for pet-supply inventory.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices; purchase orders; HS-6-digit product classification; courier/bill-of-lading records; supplier due-diligence file containing sanctions-screening results and bank references.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Share-capital and subordinated-shareholder-loan injections enter Samoa exclusively by SWIFT MT103 to a foreign-currency account in the IC's legal name at a licensed Samoan bank. Wire memo (field 70) must state 'INWARD CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / WS_IC / ISIC 4791'; the licensed bank codes the transfer under Balance-of-Payments category 5211 (Equity Capital) on its CBS exchange-control return. Verification steps: remitter identity matched to the UBO register, certified board authorization, and source-of-funds records. Routing via third-country shell banks or digital-EMI pass-through accounts must be avoided because it breaks the correspondent audit trail and triggers de-risking. Capital receipt must be booked to the IC capital ledger and the CBS authorization/confirmation retained for future dividend and liquidation remittances.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and logistics disbursements clear by: (i) SWIFT MT103 priority remittance for high-value supplier invoices, intercompany loan servicing, and tax/government fees; (ii) commercial letters of credit (irrevocable sight L/Cs) issued through the ANZ/BSP Samoa trade desks or their offshore parent banks for large inventory purchase orders; and (iii) push-pull settlement instructions to Stripe/PayPal for payment-gateway fees and refund obligations. Correspondent clearing is effected in USD, EUR, or AUD through the parent banks' New York, Sydney, and Auckland corridors; WST-denominated outward current payments require CBS exchange-control settlement approval only in non-trade cases. Every outward instruction must be sanctions-scanned (OFAC/EU) and reference-matched to underlying purchase orders and commercial invoices.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC forward contracts (USD/WST, USD/AUD, and EUR/USD) with ANZ Bank Samoa or Bank of South Pacific Samoa, limited to underlying transactional exposure and requiring bank-supported UBO documentation.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST executed with non-resident OECD-licensed bank counterparties, permitted only with prior CBS notification/approval as a capital-account derivative.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD card-collection flows and the functional settlement currency, permitted where the swap maturity matches the operating cash-flow cycle and the counterparty is a CBS-recognized international bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal Fee (in lieu of an annual return; International Companies file no annual return or financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; annual fee scaled by authorized capital (approximately US$150–US$400)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge; failure to pay within 90 days after the anniversary may result in administrative strike-off and vesting of assets in the State.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Registered Agent Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained at the Samoa registered office and maintained by the licensed registered agent; available for inspection by MCIL and the Samoa International Finance Authority upon demand (no public filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Verification performed as at the incorporation anniversary; records must be amended within 14 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain current UBO records is an offence; penalties apply to both the company and the registered agent, including potential suspension of the agent's license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Resident Agent Continuation Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa (processed through the annual license renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the incorporation anniversary renewal; automatically lapses if the annual fee is unpaid
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Termination of registered agent services may trigger the Registrar's strike-off powers; 10% late-payment penalty applies to renewals submitted after the anniversary.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable: International Companies under Samoa's International Companies Act 1987 are exempt from mandatory statutory audit regardless of turnover, assets, or member count; audit is required only if the company's articles of association or a shareholder resolution expressly imposes it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory framework for International Companies; voluntary IFRS adoption is the market standard; financial records must accurately reflect transactions but no financial statements are filed with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must obtain, verify, and maintain a beneficial ownership register at the Samoa registered office; the register is refreshed annually at the incorporation anniversary and must be updated within 14 days of any share transfer, allotment, or change in beneficial ownership; a written annual attestation is prepared and kept on file, but is not filed publicly.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Statutory Minute Book (members' and directors' resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – USD 800 per annum (inclusive of government renewal fee, registered office, resident agent, and UBO register maintenance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 only if audit is voluntarily required by the articles of association; otherwise not applicable

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC) under the Samoan International Companies Act 1987, s.200 (ring-fenced statutory exemption); 27% for a resident domestic company under the Income Tax Act 2015.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory tax exemption for the life of the IC: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend withholding tax, no interest or royalty withholding obligations, no estate duty and no stamp duty on IC transactions; the only recurring charge is the annual government fee calculated on authorized share capital.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (Statement of Compliance) under Part IX of the International Companies Act 1987, submitted by the licensed Samoa registered agent through the Registrar of International Companies portal at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); no direct online access for the beneficial owner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before each incorporation anniversary date; the annual government fee is payable at the same time and no notice of reminder is sent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal English name and the unique ICO registration number recorded in the International Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transliterated Chinese trading names may appear in marketing material but not in the statutory return; the registered legal name must be used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Samoan address of the registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A postal box alone is insufficient; the agent's address is the registered office and must remain staffed in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, license number and contact details of the Samoa-licensed international company service provider.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent file must contain the beneficial ownership particulars required by the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the actual business activity, e.g. electronic retailing of pet supplies and pet care devices (ISIC 4791).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the global e-commerce model precisely; general wording such as 'investment' is a red flag for the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC has not carried on business with Samoan residents or derived Samoan-source income during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any true sale to a Samoa customer through Stripe/PayPal voids the s.200 exemption and must be disclosed to a tax advisor immediately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation and remittance of the prescribed annual fee based on authorized share capital and share class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee is a fixed government tariff, not a tax; late payment triggers an automatic surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the annual fee attracts an automatic late-payment surcharge; continued non-payment for the statutory notice period leads to administrative striking-off from the register, forfeiture of the company's assets, and restoration costs; the registered agent may also be fined or de-licensed.
